sections.name: summary
sections.value: Phase 4 — Self-hosting + handover. Fix the latent CI package-smoke assertion (caught pre-push), reconcile the exports freeze + dd-surface once Jordan's OQ rulings land (inherits P3 tk-0002 hold), formalize the self-host proof, migrate the dd-next backlog with annotations, assemble the koala handover packet, then the END STATE: first push of main (34+ commits) with CI green. Logical group: PROOF BY CONSUMPTION + HANDOVER.

value.title: Fix the latent CI defect: package-smoke job asserts the CURRENT dd status contract (ok/exit 0/ported[10]) instead of the stale unconfigured/exit-2 snapshot; add the pack-gate job to CI; sweep ci.yml + release.yml for any OTHER assertion about behaviour that phases 1-3 changed (the out-of-diff guardrail applied to CI itself)

Exports freeze completion + dd-surface reconcile (INHERITS the P3 tk-0002 hold): when Jordan rules OQ-1/OQ-2, transcribe verbatim per doctrine, freeze the map, extend the consumer-surface test, reconcile docs dd-surface notes; until ruled this task is HELD, never guessed

Self-host proof formalized: local dd build --check clean over ALL repo documents in CI (a just recipe + CI step), prime workflow permanently on the local bin (already switched at tk-0003 landing), harness plan validate still green as the semantic gate

Migrate the 17-item dd-next backlog into docs/backlog.md with status/ownership annotations + the #8-before-#11 ordering constraint verbatim; add the exemplar-corpus question (from the P3 esc-4 ruling) as a new annotated row routed to Jordan alongside #8/#10; OPEN items stay open

Handover packet for pij-related-koala: tarball + frozen exports map + F-04 surface notes + basis SHA d08f4942 + wire-format banner note (upstream siblings diff on swap) + renderer-skew window note + the stay-behind test list (11) + open backlog pointer; send the pointer to koala
END STATE: push main to origin (first push — full history), watch CI to green, fix-forward anything red; record the green run URL in the execution log

tk-0001.assertion: ci.yml package-smoke asserts ok/exit-0/ported[10]; pack-gate job present; the CI-config sweep found-and-fixed or found-nothing is recorded in the execution log with the grep used
tk-0001.note: instrument: yaml diff + recorded sweep; final proof is tk-0006 green run

tk-0002.assertion: Jordan ruling transcribed verbatim in the exports-decision note; exports map frozen; consumer-surface test covers the frozen map incl. plan barrel per ruling; dd-surface notes reconciled — OR the task is explicitly HELD with the escalation on record
tk-0002.note: instrument: note file + vitest + open_questions states

tk-0003.assertion: just recipe + CI step run local dd build --check over every .dd.json in the repo and exit 0; a deliberate scratch drift makes the step FAIL (red proven, reverted)
tk-0003.note: instrument: red-then-green in execution log + CI step

tk-0004.assertion: docs/backlog.md carries all 17 rows + annotations + the ordering constraint verbatim + the new exemplar-corpus row; diff against upstream dd-next.md shows only formatting + the added row

tk-0005.assertion: handover-packet file committed with all named contents; pij send to pij-related-koala carries the pointer; koala ack or 48h-silence recorded

tk-0006.assertion: origin/main == local main; CI run green; run URL in execution log lg entry
tk-0006.note: instrument: git rev-parse origin/main + gh run watch exit
